packageRules.description: D-36 automerge: patch, minor, digest and pin updates inside the bounds merge by squash once required checks is green; majors open a PR.
Micronaut 4 only (D-36): core, platform, test, graphql, docs and the Gradle plugins stay below Micronaut 5.
micronaut-build (io.micronaut.build.shared.settings) stays on the 7.x line that Micronaut 4 uses (D-34, D-36).
Groovy stays on the 4.0.x line that Micronaut 4 supports (D-36).
Shadow stays below 9, the line after the one micronaut-gradle-plugin 4.x builds against (D-36).
Kotlin and KSP follow the core BOM's kotlin2 line; minor and major moves are made by hand (D-36).
graphql-java majors are promoted by an issue after the latest canary is green (D-35, D-36).
java-dataloader pins are the floor's 3.2.x and the ceiling's 6.0.x lines (versions audit, #295); only patch updates apply.
Each mise overlay is one JDK line; a new GA JDK replaces it through the versions audit (D-36).
Actions digests and tags go in one PR per week.
mise tools (java overlays, actionlint) go in one PR per week.
Renovate commits and PR titles use the repo's conventional form build(deps): (overrides the preset's chore/fix types).
